## How the guide defines it

Not addressed in guide.

## How the guide uses it

pp. 28–37 is a ten-page feature, 'The Coaching Carousel Never Stops'. The guide tracks every head-coaching change into the 2026 season and treats a first-year coach as a distinct betting condition, not merely a news item.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

The annual churn of head-coaching and coordinator jobs, and the roster and scheme disruption that follows a change.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

It is the guide's most consequential single input after the quarterback. 27 of the 29 win-total bets on pp. 22–27 rest at least partly on a coaching situation.

## How bettors use it in this guide

As a comparison class. Rather than judging a hire on reputation, Makinen looks at what happened to comparable programmes: Connecticut's eight comparable teams that also changed head coach fell 29% and -4.4 wins, and that figure carries the bet even though Jim Mora's replacement has a strong record of his own.

## Where it appears

pp. 28–37 for the feature; pp. 40–44 for the Stability systems that quantify it; pp. 22–27 for the bets.
